text:
Athena

 Local-first memory, decision engine, and governance harness for AI agents — portable across any IDE. 

 Own the state. Rent the intelligence. Persistent memory, structured reasoning,
and governed AI agents that work across any LLM — stored as plain Markdown and JSONL
on your disk across Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and VS Code.

 
 
 
 

 

Quickstart · How It Works · Structure · SDK & MCP Tools · Docs · Why Athena? · Safety

 

---

 The Problem: Stateless AI is an Amnesiac Bottleneck

Why do AI coding assistants still give generic, textbook answers? Because frontier LLMs are fundamentally stateless. 

Every time you open a new session, the model starts from zero. It has no memory of your architecture, your past post-mortems, your risk tolerance, or your code invariants. To get useful work done, you are forced to pay an Amnesia Tax — spending 10 minutes writing prompt essays explaining your stack and constraints. Worse, platform memory is designed to agree with you faster (sycophancy), not to stress-test your assumptions when stakes are high.

Athena solves this by separating intelligence (the rented model) from state (your sovereign disk):

 Dimension Stateless Chatbots (Rented RAM) Stateful Agent with Athena (Owned Hard Drive) 
 :--- :--- :--- 
 Memory & Context Amnesiac: starts from zero; 10-minute prompt prep tax Continuous: /start restores active tasks & invariants in 1 wave ( 5.4 KB Turn-1 AGENTS.md , No Python / CLI? Grab the copy-paste 0-code 3-file starter ( active context.md , rules.md , decisions.md ) for regular ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini web chats.
 Full install (cloud sync + cross-encoder reranking): pip install -e ".[full]" 
 See Getting Started for Windows, advanced config, and Supabase setup.

 How It Works

 

 Three operating modes, one compounding loop: 

 Mode Lifecycle Token Budget Retrieval & Compute Strategy 
 :----- :---------- :------------- :----------------------------- 
 Sniper ( SNIPER , Lambda /end 500 tokens vector mode="local" ( work - /end 5.4 KB Turn-1 AGENTS.md ( 12.5 KB / 3.1K full boot set) 25 ), hard 5.5s non-blocking wall cap 
 MaxMax v4.0 (Curated Compute) ( ULTRA , Lambda 30 ) /ultrastart - /ultrathink - /ultraend Most AI-agent READMEs state every claim in the same confident voice. This one doesn't. 

 Claim Status Evidence 
 :------ :------- :--------- 
 Storage & hybrid retrieval — memories stored and surfaced when relevant ✅ Shipped ( code-enforced ) Hybrid 5-channel RRF + exponential recency decay + ONNX mini-batch rerank + self-healing SQLite cache, hardened through logged regressions 
 Portability — Markdown and JSONL on your disk, movable across models ✅ Shipped ( structural ) Plain files on disk — inspect the repo 
 Quantitative decision screening & wargaming — EEV, 1/3 Kelly, Ruin, MCDA, 2-turn game trees ✅ Shipped ( code-available ) gto engine.py & wargame.py emit SHA-256 receipts ( 107 tests); quicksave emits non-blocking warnings on unreceipted engine claims (Stop hooks removed) 
 Pre-registered problem framing — Lite/Strict frame open , R1–R14 gates & holdout eval ✅ Shipped ( code-available ) frame ledger.py & tests/test problem solving holdout.py (30-case holdout + calibration) 
 Governed autonomy — hooks block destructive commands, ungrounded claims, and secrets ✅ Shipped (partial) Fail-closed PreToolUse hooks ( "onFailure": "block" , exit 2 on malformed input) guard shlex-tokenized ruin ( rm -rf / find -delete / mv / force-push / reset --hard / shutil.rmtree ), secrets, and tainted-memory writes (tests/test ruin structured.py, tests/test memory hardening.py); shell indirection bypasses are known and tracked 
 Claim & citation tracing — verifying numeric claims, denials, and cited repo paths 🟡 Partial GTO GTO-xxxxxxxx numeric receipts, opt-in universal-negative gate ( .agent/scripts/hook epistemic gate.py ), and PostToolUse diff lint ( .agent/scripts/hook post edit lint.py ); general prose claim-entailment is not solved 
 Compounding personalization — session 2,000 recalls session 5 🟡 N=1 evidence 2,100+ sessions, 410 active protocols, and 636 case studies by the author; no multi-user study 
 Anti-sycophancy — personalization doesn't silently increase agreement 🟡 Partial mitigation Code-enforced meta-awareness gate (Claude Code hook + MCP context gate bridge; 24-case holdout in tests/test sycophancy holdout.py verifies 18/18 bait kernel injection & 0/6 false positives); downstream LLM behavior & hookless IDEs remain partial — see honest limits 

 Why publish this table? Because the failure mode of this product category is self-mythologizing — describing aspirations in the present tense. Athena's own convention (Epistemic Status) requires labeling every mechanism as code-enforced , code-available , agent-discretion , or aspirational . This table is that convention applied to the README.

 Measured, Not Claimed

 

 Metric Value Verification Command 
 :------- :------ :--------------------- 
 MinMax v2.2 Boot, ONNX Rerank & Warm Gate Anti-Goodhart Invariant : Why did our reported Hit@5 shift from 0.89 to 0.57? Lenient substring matchers count partial word overlaps as "hits," inflating benchmark scores by 36% without improving retrieval. We killed the lenient matcher because vanity metrics mask regressions. See the full breakdown: Anti-Goodhart Benchmarking in RAG.

install.title: Quickstart
install.html:
git clone https://github.com/winstonkoh87/Athena-Public.git && cd Athena-Public
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[local]"               # local install (no cloud API keys required)
athena init --ide claude                # or: antigravity, cursor, gemini, vscode, kilocode, roocode
# Or start small without scaffolding the full tree:
# athena init --ide claude --profile minimal     # 3 Markdown memory files + AGENTS.md
# athena init --profile hooks-only               # standalone PreToolUse secret + ruin hooks
athena doctor                           # verify environment & workspace health

Then type /start in your IDE's AI chat panel. Work normally. Type /end to save.

No Python / CLI? Grab the copy-paste 0-code 3-file starter (active_context.md, rules.md, decisions.md) for regular ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini web chats. Full install (cloud sync + cross-encoder reranking): pip install -e ".[full]" See Getting Started for Windows, advanced config, and Supabase setup.
